name: IntegrateIT UniFi Access
notes: Monitor one UniFi Access door and unlock it deliberately from Control4, over Ubiquiti's official local Developer API (HTTPS port 12445, customer-minted Bearer token). A configurable poll publishes DOOR_LOCKED, DOOR_POSITION, DOOR_NAME, and DEVICE_ONLINE variables and fires Door Opened/Closed, Door Locked/Unlocked, and Went Online/Offline events; remote unlock is double-gated behind the IntegrateIT license AND an explicit Allow Remote Unlock property. An access-convenience surface — not a life-safety system.
